title: Race
description: One contest for elected office on a tracked ballot, comparing its candidates side by side. Candidates link to full profiles in content/people/ through candidates[].person_id. scripts/validate.mjs validates against this file, so adding or changing a field means editing this file only.

id.description: Unique kebab-case identifier, also the output filename. Use <jurisdiction>-<office>-<year>, e.g. ca-governor-2026 or us-house-ca-16-2026.

office.description: The office being contested, e.g. "Governor" or "U.S. House, California District 16".

level.description: Which level of government the office belongs to. Decides where the race is grouped on the landing page.

election_date.description: Date of the general election, as YYYY-MM-DD.

ballot_order.description: Position on the ballot, following California Elections Code 13109: 1 Governor, 2 Lieutenant Governor, 3 Secretary of State, 4 Controller, 5 Treasurer, 6 Attorney General, 7 Insurance Commissioner, 8 Board of Equalization, 9 U.S. Senator, 10 U.S. Representative, 11 State Senator, 12 Member of the Assembly, 13 county committee, 14 judicial, 15 Superintendent of Public Instruction, 16 other school offices, 17 county, 18 city, 19 district. Use decimals to order races within one heading as the ballot does, e.g. 14.01 and 14.02 for two Supreme Court justices. The landing page lists races in this order.

summary.description: One paragraph: what the office does, whether the seat is open, and how the candidates got to the general election.

candidates.description: Everyone on the general-election ballot for this office. A judicial retention vote has exactly one entry: the justice voters are asked to keep or remove.

person_id.description: Id of this candidate's profile in content/people/. Omit if no profile exists yet; the name still renders, just without a link.

primary_result.description: How they did in the primary, e.g. "First place, 19.1%". Omit if no certified or reported figure was found.

positions.description: Their stated stance on the issues that define this race, each a concrete claim attributable to a source. For a judge in a retention vote, use it for the judicial record voters can weigh instead.

key_differences.description: Where the candidates actually disagree, in plain language. One string per difference. Omit for a single-candidate retention vote.

polling.description: Published general-election polls. Omit or leave empty if none were found.

sources.description: Sources this race page rests on.

last_updated.description: Date this file was last edited by a human, as YYYY-MM-DD.
